cases.question: Every commit in a repository so far touched only the .truthiness directory. Quote the line that supplies a revision for evidence in that case.
The hook runs outside any Git repository, but TRUTHINESS_STORE names an existing file, so the repository root is undefined. Quote the line that yields no edited paths.
cases.answer_format: Also return unknown_target_warning_emitted as a JSON boolean: whether the post-edit handler prints the generic unknown-target warning.

cases.question: A one-line excerpt "return value;" is indented by four spaces in the committed source. Quote the line of the source-matching function that lets it match despite the indentation.

A claim has three applicable relations at the query scope and revision: A (supports, event e1, observation o-a), B (supports, event e2, observation o-b) and C (disproves, event e3, observation o-c). None resolves anything. Which status results and why? Quote the line that decides it.
cases.reference: Supports and disproves outcomes together count as conflicting evidence, so the claim is recheck_required rather than retired.
